classification.difficultyReason: Add polygon side lengths, including conversion from millimetres to centimetres in part c. This is the closest supplied perimeter skill.

content.prompt: Find the perimeter of each of these shapes. Answer in cm.

spec.description: Unfilled downward-pointing triangle with a horizontal top edge and all three source side labels.
spec.mathematics: The top side is 8.6 cm, the left side is 6.9 cm and the right side is 7.4 cm. All three sides contribute to the perimeter.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied side lengths are visible; the perimeter is answer-only.

spec.description: Unfilled horizontal rectangle retaining all four labels, including the redundant opposite-side measurements.
spec.mathematics: Top and bottom sides are each 12.7 cm; left and right sides are each 8.6 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: All four supplied side lengths are visible; the perimeter is answer-only.

spec.description: Unfilled rectangle with only the top and left sides labelled, preserving the mixed units.
spec.mathematics: Top side is 7 cm and left side is 56 mm. Opposite sides of the rectangle are equal.
spec.answerVisibility: The labels 7 cm and 56 mm are visible; conversion and perimeter are answer-only.

answer.worked:
Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.
$$\begin{align*}56\text{ mm} &= 5.6\text{ cm}\\P &= 7 + 5.6 + 7 + 5.6\\P &= 25.2\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
